title: Resolvent-smoothed polynomial cylinders for the finite Q3 quartic form
question: Does the resolvent-smoothed coordinate f(q)=q/(1+q^2/16) provide a bounded finite-support cylinder with an explicit form bound, first-generator commutator bound, and conditional M20 approximation estimate?

model.product_cylinder: F_S=product_{x in S} f_epsilon(q_x), with sup norm <=2^m and gradient squared <=m*4^(m-1)
model.cross_form_bound: The opposite orientation pays the exact EXP-001131 factor 21.
model.first_commutator_bound: Under the declared symmetric kinetic convention, a safe squared K-form bound is 2*m*4^(m-1)/chi.
model.conditional_moment_bound: If omega(q^20)<=M20, then omega((q-f)^2)<=epsilon^2*(1+M20) because q^6<=1+q^20.

adversarial_review.check: The partial-fraction expression is checked after combining the two conjugate scalar resolvents; no complex-domain theorem is silently imported.
The sup, first-derivative and second-derivative bounds are proved from nonnegative exact polynomial gaps; grid samples are only a reproducibility audit.
The 2^m and m*4^(m-1) factors are recomputed from support size and are not volume-uniform when support grows; only fixed support is claimed.
The first-generator estimate uses a deliberately safe factor 2/chi for the symmetric p f'+f' p convention; no sharp constant is asserted.
The L2 approximation is conditional on a state M20 bound and q^6<=1+q^20; no Gibbs, beta, cutoff or thermodynamic moment bound is inferred.
Second commutators, modular transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational resolvent and polynomial inequalities only; it does not formalize the operator commutator, state moment hypothesis, QFT algebra or any limit.

qft_interface.closed: A finite-support resolvent-smoothed bounded cylinder has explicit same/cross orientation form bounds, a safe first-generator commutator bound, and a conditional M20 static approximation estimate.
qft_interface.open: Second commutators, modular/cutoff/beta transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Finite bounded cylinder bridge only; no common infinite-volume dynamics, heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner.

no_overclaim: This package closes only the declared finite-support resolvent-smoothed cylinder estimates under an explicit M20 hypothesis for the approximation clause. It does not close the full polynomial observable algebra, modular dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
